summary: The main article describes the photocatalytic dehydrogenation of benzylic alcohols to carboxylic acids using a single ruthenium NHC complex. It includes optimization tables, comparative studies of various ruthenium complexes, substrate scope analysis, and a detailed mechanistic proposal supported by ESI-MS and NMR data.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: a) Thermal dehydrogenation of alcohols to carboxylic acids using water; b) this work; c) mechanistic overview: thermal vs photocatalytic (aad).
items.description: This scheme compares the traditional thermal oxidation of alcohols with the current photocatalytic approach and provides a general mechanistic overview.
